blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle samajh lein ke \({}^{10}P_{5}\) ka matlab kya hai: 10 alag alag cheezon mein se 5 utha kar unhein tarteeb (order) se rakhne ke kitne tareeqe hain.
Humein sirf is ki value nikalni hai.
Plan: formula \({}^{n}P_{r} = \frac{n!}{(n-r)!}\) lagayenge, neeche wala factorial cancel karenge, aur 10 se neeche ki taraf 5 numbers ko multiply karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n = 10\) (kul cheezein), \(r = 5\) (jitni chunni hain).
Humein find karna hai: \({}^{10}P_{5}\).
Tareeqa: \({}^{n}P_{r} = \frac{n!}{(n-r)!}\). Cancel karne ke baad yeh hamesha \(n\) se shuru ho kar neeche ki taraf \(r\) numbers ka product ban jata hai.

Formula mein values rakhein
\[{}^{10}P_{5} = \dfrac{10!}{(10-5)!}\]
\[= \dfrac{10!}{5!}\]
Kyun: \(n = 10\) aur \(r = 5\) rakhe, aur bracket mein \(10 - 5 = 5\) aaya. Pehle bracket hal karna zaroori hai, warna log \(10!\) ko \(10!\) se cancel kar baithte hain.

\(5!\) ko cancel karein
\[= \dfrac{10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6 \cdot 5!}{5!}\]
\[= 10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6\]
Kyun: \(10!\) ko poora khol kar likhne ki zaroorat nahi. Hum \(10!\) ko \(10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6 \cdot 5!\) likh dete hain, taake upar aur neeche wala \(5!\) seedha cancel ho jaye. Is se bara hisaab bach jata hai.

Multiply karein
\[10 \cdot 9 = 90,\quad 90 \cdot 8 = 720\]
\[720 \cdot 7 = 5040\]
\[5040 \cdot 6 = 30240\]
Kyun: Ek waqt mein do numbers multiply karein aur jawab aage le kar chalein (running total). Is tarah ghalti ka chance kam hota hai.

Tasdeeq
Box method se: 5 jagahein hain; pehli jagah ke liye 10 choices, doosri ke liye 9, phir 8, 7 aur 6.
\[10 \times 9 \times 8 \times 7 \times 6 = 30240 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Har jagah bharne ke baad ek cheez kam ho jati hai. Yaad rakhiye: \({}^{n}P_{r}\) mein hamesha theek \(r\) factors hote hain, yahan 5.

blocks.explanation:
\({}^{5}P_{2}\) ka matlab: 5 alag cheezon mein se 2 ko tarteeb se rakhne ke tareeqe.
Humein is ki value chahiye.
Plan: wohi formula, neeche \(3!\) aayega jo cancel ho jayega, aur upar sirf do numbers bachenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n = 5\), \(r = 2\).
Humein find karna hai: \({}^{5}P_{2}\).
Tareeqa: \({}^{n}P_{r} = \frac{n!}{(n-r)!}\); yeh formula har permutation ki value deta hai.

Values rakhein
\[{}^{5}P_{2} = \dfrac{5!}{(5-2)!} = \dfrac{5!}{3!}\]
Kyun: \(5 - 2 = 3\), is liye neeche \(3!\) aaya.

Cancel karke multiply karein
\[= \dfrac{5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3!}{3!}\]
\[= 5 \cdot 4 = 20\]
Kyun: \(5!\) ko \(5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3!\) likha taake \(3!\) cancel ho jaye. Ab sirf 2 factors bache, kyunke \(r = 2\) hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{5!}{3!}\) ko \(\frac{5}{3}\) samajh lena bari ghalti hai; factorials ko seedha divide nahi karte.

Tasdeeq
2 jagahein: pehli ke liye 5 choices, doosri ke liye 4 (kyunke ek cheez pehle hi rakh di).
\[5 \times 4 = 20 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Box method aur formula ek hi jawab dete hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan dilchasp baat yeh hai ke \(r = n = 7\), yani saari 7 cheezein tarteeb se rakhni hain.
Humein \({}^{7}P_{7}\) ki value nikalni hai.
Plan: formula lagayenge; neeche \(0!\) aayega jis ki value 1 hoti hai, to jawab \(7!\) ban jayega.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n = 7\), \(r = 7\).
Humein find karna hai: \({}^{7}P_{7}\).
Tareeqa: \({}^{n}P_{r} = \frac{n!}{(n-r)!}\) aur yeh baat ke \(0! = 1\).

Values rakhein
\[{}^{7}P_{7} = \dfrac{7!}{(7-7)!} = \dfrac{7!}{0!}\]
\[= \dfrac{7!}{1} = 7!\]
Kyun: \(0! = 1\) definition se hai. Kitab ne \(0!\) ko 1 isi liye maana hai taake \({}^{n}P_{n}\) ka jawab \(n!\) aaye, jo box method se bhi aata hai.
Dhyan dein: \(0! = 0\) likhna aam ghalti hai; phir neeche zero aa jata hai aur sawal hi bigar jata hai.

\(7!\) nikaalein
\[7! = 7 \cdot 6 \cdot 5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1\]
\[= 42 \cdot 120 = 5040\]
Kyun: \(7 \cdot 6 = 42\) aur \(5! = 120\) yaad hota hai, phir \(42 \times 120 = 5040\). Chhote factorials (\(5! = 120\), \(6! = 720\), \(7! = 5040\)) zabaani yaad kar lein, imtihan mein waqt bachta hai.

Tasdeeq
7 jagahein: 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 choices; product \(5040\) \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Saari \(n\) cheezein tarteeb se rakhne ke hamesha \(n!\) tareeqe hote hain.

blocks.explanation:
\({}^{10}P_{3}\): 10 alag cheezon mein se 3 tarteeb se rakhne ke tareeqe.
Humein value nikalni hai.
Plan: formula, neeche \(7!\) cancel, upar 10, 9, 8 ka product.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n = 10\), \(r = 3\).
Humein find karna hai: \({}^{10}P_{3}\).
Tareeqa: \({}^{n}P_{r} = \frac{n!}{(n-r)!}\).

Cancel karke multiply karein
\[= \dfrac{10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7!}{7!}\]
\[= 10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8 = 720\]
Kyun: \(7!\) dono taraf cancel ho gaya. \(r = 3\) hai, is liye theek 3 factors bache: 10, 9 aur 8. \(10 \times 9 = 90\), \(90 \times 8 = 720\).

Tasdeeq
Box method: \(10 \times 9 \times 8 = 720\) \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: 3 jagahein, 10, 9 aur 8 choices. Ek dilchasp baat: part (i) mein \({}^{10}P_{5}\) ke pehle teen factors bhi yahi the.
